calibration_scope: Multi-speaker pilot dataset clips scored through live model wrappers (SpeechBrain ECAPA + raw-waveform AASIST)
calibration_disclaimer: This calibration is an exploratory pilot sample on prerecorded dataset clips. It does NOT establish validated live microphone population security or operational FAR/FRR. Thresholds are derived strictly using the reproducible DEV-only calibration procedure. The EVAL partition is a pilot validation feedback set, NOT an untouched final test set.

protocol_partitions.dev_partition: Development set used for logistic regression fusion training and threshold derivation (21 trials)
protocol_partitions.eval_partition: Pilot validation feedback set used for gate inspection and failure analysis (21 trials)
protocol_partitions.test_partition: RESERVED - Future untouched test partition to be collected and evaluated only after models/policies are frozen

score_inversion_finding.description: Beta genuine CM score (-6.2595) is lower than both target attack scores (-6.0606, -5.8459).
score_inversion_finding.mathematical_implication: No single CM cutoff can accept genuine Beta while rejecting both attacks.
score_inversion_finding.measured_cost: Under strict gated policy, 4/4 target attacks and 8/8 human impostors are rejected, but genuine acceptance is 1/3 (33.3%).

high_convenience.description: Permissive convenience tier targeting 100% TAR on DEV at the expense of attack rejection. Accepts 1/8 DEV impostors and 3/4 EVAL target spoofs. Genuine acceptance on EVAL is an empirical pilot observation, not an operational guarantee.
high_convenience.derivation_rule: DEV-only: Set at DEV human impostor score ceiling (tau_fus = max(S_imp,dev)).

balanced.description: Balanced operational policy calibrated on DEV separating authentic users from impostors.
balanced.derivation_rule: DEV-only: Exact arithmetic midpoint boundary (tau_fus = (max(S_imp,dev) + min(S_gen,dev))/2).

strict_security.description: High security operational policy with mandatory anti-spoof safeguard gate. Blocks attacks even when voice similarity is high, with measured trade-off in genuine rejection.
strict_security.derivation_rule: DEV-only: Set at genuine DEV score floors (tau_fus = min(S_gen,dev), tau_cm = min(S_gen,dev)) with mandatory CM gate.
